title: Identification of small molecule inhibitors of RAD52 for breast cancer therapy: in silico approach.
authors: Kumar, Mukesh; Dubey, Rajni; Kumar Shukla, Prakash; Dayal, Deen; Kumar Chaubey, Kundan; Tsai, Lung-Wen; Kumar, Sanjay
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选RAD52蛋白的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: The breast cancer susceptibility gene 1/2 (BRCA1/2) are the key regulators in maintaining the genomic integrity and mutations in these genes have been associated with development of breast and ovarian cancers. Also, synthetic lethality has been shown in BRCA1/2 deficient cancers, when the RAD52 gene is silenced by shRNA or small molecules aptamers, suggesting a role for RAD52 in the breast cancers pathogenesis. Thus, to find the potential inhibitors of RAD52, a collection of 21,000 compounds from the ChemBridge screening library was screened to conduct molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation (MD) against RAD52. Further, the results were validated by a density functional theory (DFT) analysis and using post-dynamics free energy calculations. Out of all screened molecules, the docking study revealed five compounds were found to have promising activities against RAD52. Moreover, the catalytic amino acid residues of RAD52 developed stable contacts with compound 8758 and 10593, as anticipated by DFT calculation, MD simulation, and post dynamics MM-GBSA energy calculation. It appears that compound 8758 is the best inhibitor against RAD52 followed by 10593 compared to the other top hits, in terms of the HOMO orbital energy (-1.0966 eV and -1.2136 eV) from DFT and the post dynamics binding free energy calculation (-54.71 and -52.43 Kcal/mol). Furthermore, a drug-like properties of lead molecules (8758 and 10593) were also seen via ADMET analysis. Based on our computational analysis, we hypothesize that a small molecule 8758 and 10593 possess the therapeutic potential in the management for breast cancer patients with a BRCA mutation via targeting RAD52.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌易感基因1/2（BRCA1/2）是维持基因组完整性的关键调控因子，这些基因的突变与乳腺癌和卵巢癌的发生相关。此外，在BRCA1/2缺陷型癌症中，当RAD52基因通过shRNA或小分子适配体沉默时，已显示出合成致死效应，提示RAD52在乳腺癌发病机制中发挥作用。因此，为寻找RAD52的潜在抑制剂，从ChemBridge筛选库中收集了21,000种化合物，用于针对RAD52进行分子对接和分子动力学模拟（MD）。进一步，通过密度泛函理论（DFT）分析和动力学后自由能计算对结果进行了验证。在所有筛选的分子中，对接研究显示五种化合物对RAD52具有潜在活性。此外，RAD52的催化氨基酸残基与化合物8758和10593形成了稳定接触，这通过DFT计算、MD模拟和动力学后MM-GBSA能量计算得到预期。与其他顶级命中化合物相比，就DFT的HOMO轨道能量（-1.0966 eV和-1.2136 eV）和动力学后结合自由能计算（-54.71和-52.43 Kcal/mol）而言，化合物8758似乎是针对RAD52的最佳抑制剂，其次是10593。此外，通过ADMET分析还观察到了先导分子（8758和10593）的药物样性质。基于我们的计算分析，我们假设小分子8758和10593通过靶向RAD52，在管理携带BRCA突变的乳腺癌患者中具有治疗潜力。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
